comments.content: [medium] Performance/robustness concern: `RelationGetHypercoreInfo(rel)` gets invoked inside the inner loop on every attribute. If that function isn't trivial (e.g., a cache lookup), this adds unnecessary overhead, and repeated calls also raise the odds of running into invalidation edge cases. Better to fetch it once per `IndexOptInfo` (outside the `for (i...)` loop); and if resilience to invalidation is needed, copy just the required `columns[]` flags into locals before making further planner calls.
[low] The lifecycle of `hinfo` could be clearer if this code documented who owns its updates.
[low] Please document what callers should expect when `hinfo` is unavailable.
